title: lukefwalton.com: Durable Website Archive and Source Corpus
description: Public preservation mirror and source corpus of lukefwalton.com, the canonical personal site of Luke F. Walton. Generated automatically from the site: every published record as verbatim Markdown and plain HTML with a machine-readable catalog (catalog.json / catalog.jsonl), surface records for the site's identity pages, the public entity network (entity-network.json / .jsonld), and an asset manifest (assets.json) listing every referenced media file with checksum, size, rights status, archive policy and provenance. Media binaries are included only when their recorded policy allows it: Luke-controlled photographs, cover art and graphics, FEiN material, artwork commissioned for Luke-controlled releases, papers, and selected masters. Public-internet evidentiary captures (credit panes, playlist placements, press, social posts, platform records) are retained as documentary evidence with third-party rights acknowledged and are not relicensed. Some referenced assets (client artwork, third-party photography, undocumented masters) are intentionally metadata-only. This is a mixed-rights archive. Luke F. Walton's original material is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Third-party evidence remains owned by its respective rights holders and is not licensed under those terms. The Zenodo license field on this record is a record-level conservative rights classification (other-closed), not the license of every contained work. Copyright: © Luke F. Walton for original material. Third-party evidence remains with its respective rights holders. RIGHTS.md is the authority for the distinctions.
